members.text: The observed console sidebar groups Members under Account and links to /manage-members/. In the owner team context, that page shows Members and Roles tabs, Invite, and More team options. The sidebar has no Host Teams item.
members.limit: Observed navigation only; absence from this sidebar is not a proof that no separate route can exist.
members.retention: Raw screenshots/DOM are retained in the local research evidence directory; account and machine details are excluded from the public evidence export.

machines.text: In the joined host team with manager role, Hosting contains a Machines link at /host/machines/. Five machines are shown. Card view and List view controls are present. The compact list contains machine rows and status controls. Expanding a row shows GPU, network, CPU, disk, motherboard, occupancy, running/stored counts, temperature and listing details.
machines.limit: Visible fields and navigation only. No validation of telemetry accuracy, health calculations or machine operation.
machines.retention: Raw screenshots/DOM are retained in the local research evidence directory; account and machine details are excluded from the public evidence export.

listing.text: The selected machine Settings dialog has Listing Settings, Machine Maintenances and Problem Reports tabs. Listing Settings displays On-demand Price, Min bid Price, Upload Price, Download Price, Storage Price, Min GPUs Per Instance, Reserved Instance Pricing Factor, Add Volume Disk, volume size/price, Listing expiration date, and Automatically renew contracts after expiration. Cancel, Unlist Machine and Update Listing are visible. Min GPUs Per Instance and Reserved Instance Pricing Factor are disabled in this context. Cancel closed the dialog without any input changes or submission.
listing.context: Joined host team; manager role; one listed H100 machine
listing.limit: Field presence only; not edit permission, price calculation, saved configuration or contract behavior.
listing.retention: Raw screenshots/DOM are retained in the local research evidence directory; account and machine details are excluded from the public evidence export.

escalation.text: At Account > Settings in the owner team context, Escalation Contact is present. Expanding it shows: Provide escalation contact information for urgent issues with your hosted machines. Escalation Email. Escalation Phone Number. Save. The joined host team manager context instead showed Referral Link, Environment Variables, Marketing Emails, Early Access and Discord, without Escalation Contact. No contact was entered or saved.
escalation.context: Owner team and a different joined team with manager role
escalation.limit: This comparison does not isolate role from account/team configuration; it cannot establish a universal manager-permission rule or contact delivery.
escalation.retention: Raw screenshots/DOM are retained in the local research evidence directory; account and machine details are excluded from the public evidence export.

owner_menu.text: In the owner team context, More team options on the Members page opens a menu containing Edit Team Name, Transfer Team Ownership and Delete Team. No menu option was selected; Escape dismissed the menu.
owner_menu.limit: Visible owner controls only; no rename, transfer, deletion or permission-enforcement test.
owner_menu.retention: Raw screenshots/DOM are retained in the local research evidence directory; account and machine details are excluded from the public evidence export.

notifications.text: In the individual account context, Account > Settings links to /settings/. The expandable section is labeled Notification and Webhook Settings, and opening it selects /settings/?section=notifications. It contains Account, Instance and Host groups. Host contains Machine offline, Machine verification failed, Machine issue detected, Machine reported by renter, Machine disk space low, Machine listing ending soon and Maintenance window confirmed. Save was disabled. The section was absent from the inspected owner-team and joined manager-team settings views. No notification preference was changed or saved.
notifications.context: Individual account, with separate owner-team and joined manager-team visibility observations
notifications.limit: UI visibility only. The account belongs to host teams; these observations do not establish event eligibility, delivery, persistence, or which account preferences govern team machines.
notifications.retention: Raw screenshots/DOM are retained in the local research evidence directory; account and machine details are excluded from the public evidence export.
